inputs.input: Generate the SQL query to find the number of employees in the department with the highest average salary.
inputs.output_condition: regexp("(?i)WITH filtered_data") AND regexp("(?i)SELECT.*FROM filtered_data") AND regexp("(?i)JOIN tempo") AND regexp("(?i)JOIN produto") AND regexp("(?i)WHERE.*lower\\(p\\.categoria_1\\).*LIKE.*sucos.*") AND regexp("(?i)GROUP BY")
inputs.actual_output:
WITH filtered_data AS (
    SELECT department_id, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary
    FROM employees
    GROUP BY department_id
    ORDER BY avg_salary DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(e.employee_id)
FROM employees e
JOIN filtered_data fd ON e.department_id = fd.department_id
JOIN tempo t ON e.tempo_id = t.tempo_id
JOIN produto p ON e.produto_id = p.produto_id
WHERE LOWER(p.categoria_1) LIKE '%sucos%'
GROUP BY e.department_id;
